composition_rules.continuity: Follow the same orange-edged tread through the generated scenes. Use previous approved generated frames for consistency; no computed route is required. Keep the SAME asset-defined Sol across clips: arms, stubby feet, eyes, colors and flame layers do not change design.

Use whole-face turns and a small body lean to direct attention, retaining both original oval eyes. Keep the original eyes unchanged and open; perform through pose and gesture without reshaping them. composition_rules.mechanical_readability: The generated clip must clearly show the narrated movement and correct contacts. Simplify or regenerate a scene if it is unclear.
composition_rules.narrator_eyeline: One clear upward glance toward a fixed point just above the camera when Arthur starts an exchange. Then follow the demonstrated object. Do not add repeated up/down looks within a single explanation. On the later Exactly, look up and hold the happy ending.
